product.summary: You supply two ordinary six-sided dice and a cup each; everything else is in the box. A printed backgammon set built as a small Sun: twenty-four radial lanes in two tones of orange fan out from a raised centre bar, and the rim is a crown of forty-eight separate curled flames standing off the disc's own circular edge, no two the same length. Thirty teardrop drops, fifteen cream and fifteen dark brown, travel the lanes under the ordinary 1911 rules, which come with it in full.
